I replied to Ilse in our DM to confirm I've noted that the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July, and that I'll keep it between us.

I didn't save it to GBrain or to my own memory. GBrain is a shared brain that other members' requests read from, and my memory loads into every conversation I have, so either one could leak a note Ilse asked to keep private. That also means I have no lasting record of the date beyond our DM.

I searched GBrain for Quarrendon Freight Lines and found nothing about a paperwork cutoff that conflicts with the new date. No other action was needed.
